The Ovivor scheme.

Every item in the Ovivor scheme carries a driyuk number, which is a whole number.

The condition.

An item whose driyuk number exceeds 50 takes the value zelxil. An item whose driyuk number does not exceed 50 takes the value nakclo.

An instance.

An item whose driyuk number is 57 takes the value zelxil.
